g.text: Collaboration is by plain function calls into shared, validated code. The only LLM agents are Ask Analyst and Claims Intake Assistant (two separate LangGraph graphs).
Does: turns free-text claim emails into structured lines and runs each
through the checker; email text never changes a verdict
Out: claim lines + verdicts; INR 1.44 cr of credited claims that need a
Downstream: Claim Gatekeeper, then claims desk
Does: guides a claim filing: classify intent, collect fields, validate,
Out: claim_no + summary; reply wording by model, figures guarded
Tools: claim checker, SQLite; model only for intent fallback and
Downstream: Claim Gatekeeper rules, SQLite, Review Queue (human)
Does: replays all 4,503 claims in date order and buckets credited and
Out: T1, T2, hold, review, unverifiable buckets; by stockist; stored in
Downstream: Opportunity Register, Recovery page, Recovery List
Does: answers a leader's question with a sourced figure: input guard,
model picks a tool, tool guard, tools, output guard (max 12 trips)
Out: answer + evidence + flags + usage; ungrounded figures flagged
Downstream: analysis and claim engines; OpenRouter gpt-4o-mini
CODE ONLY · backend/agent/claim_checks.py (the one claim rule set)
Does: checks one claim: window, cumulative quantity, repeats, invoice;
recommends APPROVE, REJECT or NEEDS A PERSON with clause and file lines
In: stockist, batch, quantity, date, type
Out: verdict, tier T1 to T4, rule id, policy clause, evidence rows
Upstream: Mailbox Triage, Intake Assistant, Recovery Analyst, Ask
Does: lists every money finding with class, formula, evidence, owner,
finding agent and a validated flag. Headline: INR 51.53 L credited cash
Out: 10 opportunities, 7 classes, no cross-class total
Upstream: Recovery Analyst, Supply and FEFO Watcher, Scheme Order Gate
Downstream: Recovery Register page, dashboard KPI
Does: stock cover by C&F, spare stock elsewhere, FEFO breaches, short-
Out: cover months, shortage split, FEFO % per C&F
Downstream: Allocation, FEFO, Cap page; Ask tools; Opportunity Register
Does: tests free goods against the 3% cap, scheme claim rates, and a
proposed scheme order against 2.5 months of stock
Out: cap status, claim rate, BLOCK SCHEME or not (proxy; RSM confirms)
Downstream: Scheme Returns page; Ask tools; Opportunity Register; RSM
Reconciliation of disagreements: there is no agent-to-agent negotiation. Every rule is written once (claim_checks.py, enforced by tests/test_rules.py), so agents cannot disagree on a verdict.
No cross-agent LLM handoff exists. Cheapest-first routing: Intake Assistant tries keywords before it calls the model. Ask Analyst is capped at 12 tool trips.
